title: thread.rs: Thread/get,changes
description:
Implement Thread/get and Thread/changes handler functions in src/thread.rs.

## Methods to implement
- Thread/get (RFC 8621 §4.1): fetch thread objects; each Thread has id + emailIds (ordered by date)
- Thread/changes (RFC 8621 §4.2): return thread-level created/updated/destroyed since sinceState

## Key notes
- Thread is a read-only aggregate — no Thread/set, Thread/query, Thread/queryChanges
- Thread is updated when email is added to or removed from a thread (via Email/set)
- emailIds order is chronological (oldest first) per RFC 8621 §4

## Source references
- Stalwart (AGPL — read, do not copy): ~/GIT/stalwart-jmap-server/main/crates/jmap/src/thread/
- RFC 8621 §4

## Test vectors
- Create two emails in same thread → Thread/get returns both emailIds in order
- Thread/changes after email added → thread appears in updated list
